thread:
Sam (Eng): hey @people-ops — quick note: i've had recurring vestibular migraines and the fluorescent lighting + open office has been triggering. submitting an accommodation to move to a quieter desk and to be excused from on-call for 4 weeks while i get treatment. i'll attach a note from my doc.

Jordan (Eng): curious how we cover Sam's on-call if they're excused; we've already stretched the rotation. worried this will push more night pages onto the junior folks.

Avery (Manager): thanks for flagging both points. Sam, please upload the intake so People Ops can advise. Jordan, i'll rework the on-call roster and offer overtime/backfill or swap shifts with me for the interval. we can also hire a short-term contractor if needed — i'll discuss with EngOps.

Cass (People Ops): received the intake. immediate options: private desk allocation, temporary on-call exemption up to 6 weeks, and reasonable workload rebalancing. for calibration: if the manager documents the exemption + updated expectations, we can tag the calibration packet so it isn't treated as a performance gap.

Sam (Eng): uploaded the clinician note and put 4 weeks with a 2-week check-in. thanks.

Jordan (Eng): ok appreciate the plan. can we get a short doc of who covers what so it's clear? don't want confusion during incident.

Avery (Manager): yes — i'll post a coverage matrix in the private intake thread and cc EngOps. Jordan, i'll assign you the weekend shift on 4/17 and reduce your weekday pager from 2 to 1 for the next two weeks as compensation.

CaseBot: Accommodation case AC-2026-330 created for Sam. Intake scheduled 2026-04-12 09:00 PT.

Cass (People Ops): follow-up: we'll log the adjustments (desk move, on-call exemption, coverage matrix) and set a 2-week check-in. only manager, People Ops, and EngOps will see the notes. if you want noise-cancelling headset reimbursement, submit via procurement link. :white_check_mark:
